cohort_summary: Pitcher-prop specialists found the Starters chip a promising scaffold (all five markets, exp value, BASE tags, CSV export, search-to-starter overlay, live pitch count/velo) but could not complete the core loop. The single line shown is the model's own floor(mean)+0.5 rather than the book line, there is no alt-line ladder despite a Poisson distribution being available, no book odds/edge, no sort/filter on the Starters table, and none of the inputs K bettors key on (opp lineup K% vs hand, leash/projected pitches, days rest, ump zone, velo trend). Starter props are graded in the backend but have no calibration tile, Data Feed market or result column. Live, the pitching rail lacks the pitcher's running line. Phone users struggle to even find the clipped Starters chip. 0/10 full success; pros mostly would not return until ladders + book lines exist.

personas.name: Marcus Hale
personas.profile: Pro, 9 yrs, K-prop specialist; $60k bankroll, $1.2k units; DK, FD, Circa, Pinnacle for steam; runs own K model in Python
personas.goal: Find 3-4 overs on strikeouts where model P(over) beats the no-vig price at the book line, including alt 7+ K ladders on aces.
journey: 1. Opens #/pred, sees 1+ Hit default; clicks Starters chip.
2. Scans STRIKEOUTS column: every row shows 'O 5.5' with ~45-57% over; his books have lines 4.5-7.5.
3. Looks for a way to set his own line or see 6+/7+ rungs; none. Opens a row: only matchup text + methodology note + Open game.
4. Tries to sort by Ks P(over) - headers not clickable; MIN LIFT slider gone.
5. Exports CSV hoping for a distribution; gets one line per market.
6. Concludes he would have to back out the Poisson mean from 'exp 4.7' and price ladders himself in his own sheet.
personas.quote: You've got a Poisson mean sitting right there and you show me one rung at a line nobody's hanging - give me the ladder or I'm back in my notebook.

pain_points.title: No alt-line probability ladder for starter props
pain_points.detail: Each starter market shows exactly one line (O 5.5 Ks) and one P(over). There is no 3+/4+/5+/6+/7+/8+ K ladder or outs ladder, even though the base model is a Poisson count with a known mean, so the full distribution is free to compute. Alt-ladder bettors cannot price any rung but the one the model picked.
pain_points.evidence: frontend/pitchhawk.js:2439-2443 propCellHtml renders a single line; supabase/functions/_shared/basemodels.ts:109-125 starterProp returns only {line, expected_value, probability}
pain_points.suggested_fix: Return the PMF (or P(X>=k) for k=0..12) per starter market and render an expandable ladder row in the Starters detail / phone card: 3+ 4+ 5+ 6+ 7+ 8+ with P and fair American odds per rung.

pain_points.title: The prop line is the model's own floor(mean)+0.5, not the book's line
pain_points.detail: The line shown is derived from the model mean (always the half-point just below expectation), so P(over) clusters around 40-60% and never lines up with the number posted at DK/FD. A bettor whose book has Ks at 6.5 has no P(over 6.5) anywhere in the UI.
pain_points.evidence: supabase/functions/_shared/basemodels.ts:124 `const line = Math.floor(mean) + 0.5`; Starters table every cell 'O 5.5 / 46% over'
pain_points.suggested_fix: Price the sportsbook's posted line (Odds API pitcher props) and let the user type a line: show P(over/under) at any half-point from the same distribution.

pain_points.title: No book price, implied prob, no-vig fair or edge on pitcher props
pain_points.detail: Starter cells show P(over) only. No book odds, no implied probability, no no-vig fair price, no edge %, no best-book comparison. The value step has to happen in a separate tab/spreadsheet.
pain_points.evidence: Predictions > Starters (work/c08-pitcher-props/desk_sp.png); BRIEF: /edge only covers game markets
pain_points.suggested_fix: Add BOOK / IMPLIED / FAIR / EDGE sub-columns per prop (Odds API player-props ingest already exists behind a flag); colour-code edge and sort by it.

pain_points.title: Starters table has no sort, min-edge or market filter
pain_points.detail: On the Starters chip the MIN LIFT slider disappears, there is no pSort control, and rows are fixed-sorted by 30D K% (which is '—' for every row in this env, so order is effectively arbitrary). Cannot sort by P(over Ks), expected Ks, or 'most over-lean' to find the best spot on a 14-starter slate.
pain_points.evidence: frontend/pitchhawk.js:1093-1102 predStarterRows sorts only by k; [data-act=pSort] count = 0 on #/pred?m=sp (desktop and phone)
pain_points.suggested_fix: Clickable column headers (sort by any market's P or exp), a market sub-selector (Ks/Outs/Hits/ER/BB), and an 'edge vs line' min filter.

pain_points.title: Starter CSV exports one line per market only
pain_points.detail: Export on Starters works (line + p_over per market) but omits expected value, the ladder and inputs, so modelers can't rebuild the distribution.
pain_points.evidence: pitchhawk.js:1031-1036
pain_points.suggested_fix: Include exp_* and P(X>=k) columns for k in a sensible range.

delights: Exp value shown next to every line ('exp 4.7') - at least the mean is exposed.
